result.reason: The clause adds the annual cap and business-hours restriction and retains the favorable 5% cost threshold, but it does not require advance notice: permitting an audit “within 30 days” after a request could allow an immediate audit and therefore fails both the 30-day preferred and 15-day fallback notice standards. It also does not expressly prohibit direct access to Licensee systems, and merely making the audit subject to the Agreement’s confidentiality obligations does not clearly bind the independent auditor. Moving the cost paragraph ahead of subsection (b) is unnecessary. The margin comment inaccurately characterizes the clause as satisfying the written-notice requirement.
